description: This file contains a class 'ScopeRepository' implementing the 'ScopeRepositoryInterface' for handling OAuth scope entities within the OrangeHRM system. It currently provides stub methods for retrieving scope entities by identifier and finalizing scopes, both returning default/null values.

classes.name: ScopeRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 scope management interface with stub methods for scope retrieval and finalization.

methods.name: getScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a scope entity by its identifier. Currently returns null, indicating OAuth scopes are not supported.

methods.name: finalizeScopes
methods.description: Finalizes the list of scopes for a given grant type, client, and user. Currently returns an empty array, indicating no scopes are defined.
